subject: EHSE
recommendations:
House was informed that to strengthen safety culture at FFC and align policies & procedures with international standards and industry best practices; a meeting was convened under the leadership of Director-Manufacturing with Senior leadership of FFC plant sites (GM/MM/PQ /FPCL/AGL). Please see attached MoM of said meeting as part of Annexure of EHSE meeting.
 Following points were discussed to have a roadmap for their standardized as per other FFC sites: , Safe Million Manhour Protocol
 Lockout, Tagout, Try-out (LOTOTO) Procedure, Cell Phone Usage Policy, Vehicles Protocol at Plant Sites, Synchronization of Emergency Alarms and Drills
 Note: Actions and timelines are applicable to FFC's 03 sites (GM/MM/PQ), whereas FPCL & AGL management shall plan to adopt these practices based on their existing system maturity.

subject: EHSE
recommendations:
House was informed that under the existing criteria, lumpsum and short duration contracted manpower is currently excluded from the contractor's Safe Million Man-Hours regime which is not aligned with prevailing industry best practices.
 To achieve alignment with neighbouring industry and internationally accepted practices, it was principally agreed that all categories of manpower entering plant sites, including all forms of contracted and short duration workforce, shall be included in the Safe Million Man-Hours protocol.
 To implement the revised protocol following are the actions:
 a. Form a cross-functional team to review existing criteria, identify gaps, and propose a revised Safe Million Man-Hours protocol covering all categories of contractor manpower.

subject: EHSE
recommendations: b. Develop a phased road map including revision of PSM element Contractor Safety Management Level-ll Procedure, training needs and PPEs management etc. to align with SPM best practices.

subject: EHSE
recommendations: c. Start implementation of road map from April 2026 and Implement the revised protocol across all plant sites.
